question: The core of M87 contains a massive black hole.

Astronomical observations, including stellar dynamics and gas motions near its nucleus, have long indicated the presence of a supermassive black hole at its center. This was definitively confirmed in 2019 when the Event Horizon Telescope produced the first direct image of the black hole’s shadow in M87’s core. The black hole’s mass is estimated to be several billion solar masses, making it one of the most massive known.
